# Mobile apps

## Scope

Applies when the change touches iOS, Android, cross-platform. Not when the change is a mobile-web page, which `aidd-team:web-front-end` covers, or a desktop app, which `aidd-team:desktop-apps` covers. Neighbours: `aidd-team:accessible-ui`, `aidd-team:release-rollout`, `aidd-team:secure-coding`, `aidd-team:privacy-by-default`.

## Dated obligations

| From | Obligation | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2024-05-01 | App Store Connect refuses an upload whose code, an SDK's included, uses a required-reason API without an approved reason in a privacy manifest (ITMS-91053). | S3 |
| 2025-02-17 | An app without verified DSA trader status is removed from the App Store in the EU; since 2024-10-16 an EU update needs the status. | S4 |
| 2026-04-28 | Uploads to App Store Connect are built with Xcode 26 or later and a 26 SDK. | S4 |
| 2026-08-31 | New Play apps and updates target API level 36; Wear OS and Android Automotive OS 35, Android TV and Android XR 34. | S7 |
| 2026-09-09 | iOS and iPadOS uploads target iOS 13 or later. | S4 |
| 2026-09-30 | Android developer verification for installs from participating stores in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand; global in 2027. | S8 |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd assess`) | A store-facing change (permissions, data, SDKs, payments, sign-in, accounts, children): the author declares the risk dimension it touches (major). Store review is a dependency, and the build meets the dated floors. | S2, S5, S4, S7, S8 |
| Specify | Each permission with its purpose string and, for a Play restricted permission, its Play Console declaration. The privacy manifest, App Privacy, and Data safety changes as Tasks. | S3, S5, S6 |
| Specify | Digital goods through in-app purchase (3.1.1) and Play Billing; any other payment names its exception (a 3.1.3 case, physical goods, or a Play exemption). | S2, S5 |
| Specify | Account creation brings in-app deletion (5.1.1(v)) and, on Play, a web link that deletes without the app. A social login brings an equivalent private login option (4.8). | S2, S6 |
| Specify | User-generated content has filtering, reporting, blocking, and published contact (1.2); an app for children follows the Kids Category (1.3) and Play Families rules. | S2, S5 |
| Implement | Secrets in the keystore or keychain, never in the bundle; certificate pinning where MASVS requires; no sensitive data in logs or screenshots. | S1 |
| Implement | The SDK inventory is a file beside the lockfiles (SDK, version, data collected, tracking). Tracking waits for the ATT grant. Personal data sent to a third party, third-party AI included, is disclosed and consented first (5.1.2(i)). | S3, S2 |
| Implement | No hidden or dormant feature (2.3.1(a)). No downloaded code that changes features (2.5.2). A thin web wrapper fails 4.2, a near-copy of another app 4.3. | S2 |
| Verify | Offline, background, interruption, and low-battery states tested on the lowest and newest supported OS. | S2, S7 |
| Review | The MASVS controls, MASWE weaknesses, and MASTG cases for the change's category (storage, crypto, auth, network, platform, code, resilience). | S1 |
| Ship | Notes for Review name each new feature specifically (2.3.1(a)). They give a working demo account or an approved demo mode, back end on (2.1(a)). | S2 |
| Ship | A new personal Play account runs a closed test with 12 testers opted in for 14 days first; the pre-launch report is read before promotion. | S7 |
| Ship | App Store phased release or a Play staged rollout, halted on the crash-free or ANR trigger. A shipped binary cannot be recalled, so a server-side switch is the rollback. | S2, S7 |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MobSF static scan | no high finding in the build | `uvx mobsfscan==1.0.1 .` on the source, MobSF on the binary | S1 |
| UI tests on the OS matrix | the flows work on every supported OS version | the `mobile-ui-test` runner in CI, on the lowest and newest supported OS | S2, S7 |
| Required-reason API declarations | each required-reason API the app or an SDK calls has an approved reason | the archive's symbols (`nm -u`) matched against Apple's list, diffed with `NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes` in every `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy` | S3 |
| Store SDK floors | the built artifacts meet the dated floors | bundletool 1.18.3 `dump manifest` on the AAB: `targetSdkVersion` ≥ 36; the archive's `DTSDKName` a 26 SDK, `MinimumOSVersion` ≥ 13.0 | S7, S4 |
| Sensitive permission allow-list | no permission ships undeclared or unexplained | the merged manifest (`bundletool dump manifest`) and the built Info.plist's usage-description keys against an allow-list in the repository | S5, S3 |
| SDK inventory against declarations | App Privacy and Data safety cover every SDK's data | a script: the lockfiles against the inventory, the inventory against the App Privacy answers and Data safety export kept in the repository | S3, S6 |
| Account deletion end to end | in-app deletion removes the account and its data; the web link works | a UI test that signs up, deletes, then queries the API; an HTTP check of the web deletion link with no session | S2, S6 |
| Review readiness smoke | the reviewer can sign in; no placeholder or dead link ships | the Notes for Review demo login against production; `lychee` (v0.24.2) over metadata and in-app URLs; a placeholder-text scan of strings and metadata | S2 |

- From `aidd-team:accessible-ui`: Mobile accessibility checks.

## Keep it current

Each entry is due after its `review_every_days` (else emerging 90 days, established 365) or by its `review_due`. An emerging one applies only when the change needs it, said in the Spec. One `aidd eval standards` lists as due is looked up in Specify, and a missing one is proposed to aidd's `schemas/roles.json`. Steward: @thaithienvanid, who reviews every change to this pack's standards.
